meta.description: Single-pathogen bundle: norwalk_gi only, byte-identical to the norwalk_gi entry of active_profiles.json.
meta.notes: Diagnostic bundle for NORO-GATE-FLOOR-01 Part B. Removes the sars_cov2_resp and influenza_a co-circulation so a norovirus-only areal-vs-declared canary is not confounded by cross-pathogen RNG stream shifts (NORO-TOUCH-SHARE-02 inferred 3). Not the engine default; select it with --bundle norwalk_only.

pathogens.name: Norwalk Virus (Norovirus GII.4)

illness_probability.age_factor_by_age_band_notes: Per-band multiplier on the dose-conditional Hill (the Teunis 2008 pair is the measured, dose-conditional quantity for this arm — provenance register class M — so age conditions it as a factor, not a replacement share). Sourced partition is child-vs-adult, the coarsest the literature defends: child factor 0.51 is the ratio of two kept-unpooled register regimes — pediatric community cohorts' symptomatic share of PCR-confirmed infections (Baker 2026 PREVAIL, Clin Infect Dis DOI 10.1093/cid/ciag033, ~one-third of 402 GI+GII infections in children <3 symptomatic; El-Heneidy 2022 ORChID, Pediatr Infect Dis J DOI 10.1097/inf.0000000000003667, 82/209 = 39.2%; Cannon 2026, Pediatrics DOI 10.1542/peds.2025-072461, ~two-thirds asymptomatic across enteric viruses on the same PREVAIL cohort — Grade B, community regime midpoint 0.365) over adult challenge cohorts' symptomatic share (Gray 1994 9/14, Atmar 2014 14/21, Newman 2016 19/26, Frenck 2012 GII.4 12/16, Rouphael 2022 GII.2 ~17/24 — challenge regime midpoint 0.71, interval [0.64, 0.78]). Ratio 0.365/0.71 = 0.51, Grade C as a cross-design adaptation — the register keeps the two regimes unpooled for the boarding split and this factor is their ratio, not a pooled value. Three declared caveats, not softened: (1) the child sources are 0-2y cohorts while the 'child'/'5-17' labels read 5-17 under the severity model's band convention — the fraction demonstrably RISES through childhood (never-symptomatic 71.1% in year 1 to 61.2% in year 2), so 0.51 likely understates presentation in the older half of the band; (2) no admissible design measures p(symptomatic|infection) in 65+, the register's own never_symptomatic row states so — senior, middle_aged, adult and young_adult therefore multiply 1.0 (unnamed bands) rather than reading an invented elderly split, and on a senior-skewed hull (Pavli mean 72.6) the pooled draw sits at the adult reference; (3) LTCF outbreak series (Parron 2021, Cardemil 2021, Inns 2019) report resident attack rates, not per-infection symptomatic shares — different denominator, not usable here. Not chosen against VSP, Park, or any scored anchor. HOST-AGE-02.

severity_model.base_probabilities_by_age_band_notes: Senior-vs-everything-else is the coarsest sourced partition of p(severe|symptomatic case): Calderwood 2021 (Clin Infect Dis, DOI 10.1093/cid/ciab808), the decade of US NORS LTCF outbreaks 2009-2018 (13,092 outbreaks, 416,284 outbreak-associated cases), reports 21.6 hospitalizations and 2.3 deaths per 1000 cases -> severe share 0.0239 among cases, and the model's severe rung folds hospitalization and death together (fatality_probability_by_severity is null on every arm, so both endpoints enter severe_critical, same convention the covid ladder's notes state). severe_critical = 0.0239 x the non-asymptomatic mass (0.75) = 0.017925; mild+moderate are resplit at the pooled 0.19:0.009 ratio with asymptomatic and subclinical held at the reference 0.25/0.55 (the validator requires every band to keep the reference asymptomatic share). Every band not named reads the pooled vector — no per-case severe-outcome design exists for non-institutional age groups at publishable grade, so no split is invented there. Caveats recorded, not softened: the source population is institutionalized elderly (residents AND staff cases are pooled in NORS — resident-only rates run slightly higher), institutional care differs from shipboard infirmary care, GII.4 dominates the LTCF outbreak record while this profile is GI-analog in part (the same genogroup caveat the illness_probability row carries), and on a senior-heavy hull the pooled severe share rises well above the declared 0.001 reference — measured consequence, not a defect. Trivedi 2012 (JAMA, DOI 10.1001/jama.2012.14023) corroborates the direction (all-cause mortality RR 1.11 during LTCF outbreaks), implying ~9-11% of the Calderwood rate is background rather than outbreak-attributable.

observation_model.evidence_grade: C - declared observation process, not identified (#27)
observation_model.notes: Every number in this block is a declared assumption, class C, origin Tr: the three severity vectors are Table 2 and section 4.1 of docs/norovirus/cruise_pathogen_severity_observation_priors_v2.md, which grades each entry [A] (assumed prior) and states that the decomposition is not identified by the one cruise investigation behind it - many severity-specific vectors give the same weighted fraction. That one aggregate is anchor A3, which is why A3 no longer scores (#23). Consequence, stated rather than repaired: the reported-attack-rate comparison against VSP is CONDITIONAL on this assumed observation process, and agreement with a reported rate is not evidence that these fifteen numbers are right. No entry was chosen against A1, A2, A3, A5 or any VSP quantity. Uncertainty is carried by prior.scenarios as whole coherent vectors, never by sweeping components independently, per section 8 of the same document: independent component sweeps produce reporting ladders no observer could exhibit. lab_sampling_probability_by_severity is operational rather than biological (section 9 there) and moves lab-confirmed counts only, not the VSP reported rate; it stays a declared axis. episode_reporting_window_days 2.0 is the illness duration the vectors were elicited over (uncomplicated norovirus 1-3 days), also declared. reporting_belief_scaling 'none' declares the reporting vectors realized capture - reports per eligible host, already net of every reluctance mechanism - per ledger NORO-CHANNEL-02; the Layer-1 trust_medical multiplier must not stack on them.

base_reporting.source: priors v2 Table 2 and section 4.1: the shipped decomposition, weighted eligible-case reporting about 0.61 against the 0.60 [E] aggregate. Class C, origin Tr. Not identified by that aggregate.

isolation_avoidance_post_recognition.source: priors v2 section 4.1, stated verbatim there: anticipated cabin isolation suppresses subclinical and mild presentation after outbreak recognition while moderate and severe cases stay hard to conceal. Class C, origin Tr. Direction is argued in the source; magnitude is declared.

illness_duration.notes: Harris, Iturriza-Gomara, Allen, Kelly & O'Brien 2019, 'Norovirus strain types found within the second infectious intestinal diseases (IID2) study: an analysis of norovirus circulating in the community', BMC Infect Dis 19:87, DOI 10.1186/s12879-019-3706-z (IID2: UK national community cohort, April 2008 - August 2009), Fig 4 panel C (diarrhoea, dotted curve): percent still ill by number of days following illness onset, adults and children aged >= 5 years — the model's population. S(d) is P(illness still present at d days after onset); days 10-12 are not digitizable (the legend overlies the curve) and are interpolated linearly between d=9 and d=13, where both curves sit at zero. Digitization calibration: source image media.springernature.com full/springer-static/image/art:10.1186/s12879-019-3706-z/MediaObjects/12879_2019_3706_Fig4_HTML.png (1945x1373 grayscale), panel C axis rows 334 px (0%) and 307.5 px (10%) giving 2.65 px per percentage point, x-axis label centroids giving day 0 at col 97.5 and 141.2 px per day, curve read as the topmost dark pixel per day column with the 10% reference line and axis masked; read error about +/-1 percentage point. The table's own statistics reproduce the paper's reported figures in direction and where the >=5 band is the right comparison, exactly: median T = 2 days, E[T] = 2.57 days, P(T <= 4) = 0.87 against the abstract's 83% resolved by day 4 all ages. Grade B (direct measurement of illness duration in a community cohort of the right age band, not in a cruise setting), origin F4·dig. This replaces a value previously carried from Atmar's challenge illness (1-2 days), a different population and exposure. draw 'empirical_survival' is the default under this profile's renewal arm; the historical comparator states draw 'point' explicitly.

pathogens.detectable_duration_notes: Atmar et al. 2008, Emerg Infect Dis 14(10), DOI 10.3201/eid1410.080117: 16 experimentally challenged adults, GI.1, faecal RT-PCR detectability median 28 days (range 13-56) measured from inoculation. Grade A for duration-of-RT-PCR-detectability, origin R. This is the window the asymptomatic RNA positivity boarding prevalence was measured over; it is deliberately longer than the authored 15-day shedding curve, so stationary_detectable boarding draws can land in the representability boundary state 'cleared'.

incubation.notes: Pooled norovirus GII: mu 0.182, sigma 0.445 (median 1.2 d, GSD 1.56, 95% 0.5-2.9 d) from Lee et al. 2013 via docs/ctb_incubation_spec.md - GII rather than the GI the pathogen_id implies, because this profile's genotypes are GII.4/GII.17/GII.2, and the spec finds no genotype-specific fits within GII. Dose term dose_shift 0.12 / floor 0.3 from the spec. dose_reference_log10 is this profile's own beta-Poisson N50 (16871 particles, alpha 0.111 / beta 32.81), not the spec's 18, which this note previously mislabelled as RT-PCR units: Teunis's 18 is a disaggregated-virus figure whose unit is contested in print, the fitted pair's own dose axis is administered genome copies, and neither is an RT-PCR unit (docs/literature/consensus_tranche_23_teunis_atmar_dose_unit.md). acquired_particles is in model units whose commensurability with genome copies is not established, so referencing the literature assay unit would put every simulated host on the dose floor and turn a conditioning term into a constant. Consequence: a typical (near-ID50) host presents at the literature median, and the dose effect is anchored in direction but not calibrated in magnitude. host_factors omitted deliberately: the spec finds no literature support for a frailty effect on incubation, so it stays a sensitivity arm.

symptomatic_stream.notes: Derivation of record: docs/norovirus/symptomatic_boarding_stream.md. A partition of the renewal import rate (requires rate_mode 'renewal'), not an addition: p_sym = case incidence x mean illness duration = (I/1000) x (E[T]/365.25) and p_asym = p_total - p_sym. Inputs are sourced rows, not tuned: I = 39.0 cases/1000 py ages 15-64, O'Brien et al. 2016 J Infect Dis DOI 10.1093/infdis/jiv411 Table 1 (Grade B, origin T1); E[T] = 2.5715 days from this profile's own illness_duration table, Harris et al. 2019 IID2 DOI 10.1186/s12879-019-3706-z Fig 4C (Grade B, origin F4·dig). Derived values under the dispersed arm: p_sym = 0.02746%, p_asym = 0.3936% of p_total 0.4211%, symptomatic share of the RNA-positive cohort 6.52%; under draw 'point' (E[T] = 3) p_sym = 0.03203%. Enabled by default under this profile's renewal arm; the historical comparator is rate_mode 'screening_prevalence' with prevalence passenger 0.0325 / crew 0.0185 (Grade B intervals, tranche 10 / tranche 42), age_draw 'engine_window', this stream disabled, and illness_duration.draw 'point'.

preboarding_assessment.notes: Derivation of record: docs/norovirus/preboarding_assessment.md. The VSP 2018 Operations Manual 4.1.1.2 three-day pre-boarding assessment (manual p. 31 / PDF p. 60): a boarded host whose symptom onset is within lookback_days is eligible; a declared crew case is a reportable AGE case at epoch 0 and enters ever_reported_ids directly, since the sick-call ladder only sees the currently symptomatic. lookback_days = 3 is the sourced crew clause. declaration_compliance, recall_halflife_days and denial_probability are operational sweep coordinates with no licensed point: 0 is the no-screen corner, null halflife is perfect recall, and denial of boarding is industry practice VSP never states. The passenger side is VSP-silent (the manual's only questionnaire is the 4.1.2.2.1 72-hour instrument for already-identified cases); it follows Neri et al. 2008's recommendation of embarking-passenger screening, declared as practice not regulation, and passenger reportable is a load error. The crew clause is on by default under the renewal arm; the historical comparator disables both roles explicitly. When a role is enabled the declaration/denial draws share boarding_rng, so on-vs-off matched-seed runs are not host-paired — a denial draw shifts every subsequent host's stream position; the campaign readout must compare distributions, not hosts.

symptom_axis_probabilities.notes: Kirby et al. 2016, PLoS ONE (DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0143759), Tables 1-2: 72% of symptomatic GII.2 Snow Mountain challenge subjects vomited (GI.1 Norwalk 70%), and of the GII vomiters 50% also met the diarrhoea case definition (>=3 unformed stools or >=400 g unformed stool in 24 h; GI.1 57%). Grade B, origin Tn - human challenge adults standing in for a passenger complement, GII values taken because this profile's genotypes are GII. diarrhoea_given_no_vomiting = 1.0 is not measured: illness is defined as vomiting and/or diarrhoea, so a symptomatic non-vomiter met the definition through diarrhoea. These are illness-class shares, not shedding: an asymptomatic or convalescent host draws no axes and its RNA emission is untouched.

strain_evolution.notes: Rates from docs/paper3/variant_surveillance_spec.md §1.3. superinfection_susceptibility and recombination_rate are placeholders pending a literature anchor (docs/paper3/variant_surveillance_plan.md §7). immune_waning: refractory_days 56 and half_life_days 1095 are anchored on homotypic challenge protection lasting at least months and modelled immunity duration of 4.1-8.7 years (Simmons et al., Emerg Infect Dis 2013); the homotypic HR 0.39 of Ford-Siltz et al. (Clin Infect Dis 2020) is a multi-year hazard ratio, not a per-epoch susceptibility. Both are sensitivity axes. refractory_protection is applied as a per-epoch hazard reduction, so any value below 1.0 leaks at that rate every hour: 1.0 makes within-window re-infection escape-only, which is the intended contract. genotype_classes and prior_genotype_distribution_by_era are declared per docs/proposals/pathogen_class_structure_decision.md and ledger NORO-GENO-01: the class — not the genotype — is the unit of declared strain difference. Class shares from era-resolved external typing surveillance (tranche 49: GII.4 ≈ 0.60 [0.47, 0.75] pre-2020, ≈ 0.15 [0.05, 0.30] post-2020 under the GII.17 succession; within-class genotype splits are declared conveniences, the class is the measured unit). Class secretor_negative_relative_susceptibility 0.10 vs 0.45 from Kambhampati et al. 2016 OR 9.9 (GII.4) vs 2.2 (non-GII.4), the split that drew the class boundary; the flat profile field stays as the fallback for unattributed challenges. transmissibility_multiplier 1.0 is the declared-neutral axis the mono-class canaries sweep; nothing here is fitted to VSP or any other model anchor.

sequencing_assay.notes: Assay design from docs/paper3/variant_surveillance_spec.md §2.1. read_accuracy is per-read consensus accuracy for this amplicon; read depth and the reporting floor are operator dials set at run time, not pathogen properties.

pathogens.presymptomatic_shedding_notes: Atmar et al., Emerg Infect Dis 2008: virus was first detected in stool at a median approximately 36 hours post-challenge, essentially concurrent with symptom onset; 0.5 days is the generous presymptomatic window.
